title: Central completion attribution represents actual usage without duplicate ledger rows
detail: Optional completion context lets each caller migrate atomically from its own legacy ledger write to the same best-effort central recordAiUsage path. Omitted context leaves existing caller-owned accounting unchanged. completeText forwards context without double recording; successful tool loops retain one aggregate legacy row per turn, with real model, cache-inclusive usage and profile/Space attribution. Provider failures do not invent successful usage. This is compatibility preparation only: no budget reservation, SQL migration, admission guarantee, per-attempt settlement or LIVE-883 closure. Caller migration batches LIVE-889/LIVE-890 and final LIVE-883 remain separate serial releases. Optional context is a transitional compatibility API; final LIVE-883 makes attribution mandatory and records individual attempts. The permanent probe verifies attributed completion and loop usage totals through either ledger transport without asserting that optional context persists forever.

verify.note: Executes shipped completion wrapper with synthetic provider and ledger seams; no paid calls or nested test runner.
